title: Stream framing fixes and stop-token propagation for OpenAI /v1 chat parity
author: Priya Desai
description: Motivation: customers observed two classes of incompatibilities when using the OpenAI /v1/chat.completions compatibility layer with streaming enabled: (1) stop tokens could arrive in a later streaming chunk after a function/tool call delta, causing clients to call tools with incomplete context; (2) partial logprobs and role normalization inconsistencies appeared in interim deltas which broke some SDK consumers. This PR standardizes streaming framing and ensures stop token semantics are preserved across the compat layer. Summary of changes: updated runtime streaming framer to emit deterministic chunk boundaries and attach final finish_reason only on the terminal chunk; stop token handling moved upstream into the compat translator to convert OpenAI-style stop arrays and strings into internal stop-matchers and to short-circuit generation when a stop sequence is satisfied; function-calling events are now emitted atomically: tool_call and tool_response are grouped with a canonical finish_reason mapping to OpenAI's finish_reason values; logprobs are withheld from interim deltas unless the user explicitly requests streaming logprobs via the new parameter `stream_logprobs=true`; role names passed from clients are normalized earlier in the API pipeline to avoid legacy camelCase/system/assistant mismatches; added a small heuristic to avoid emitting empty-delta chunks (addresses flakiness in several browser SDKs). Tests & validation: added unit tests for stop propagation and framing in tests/unit/streaming_framer_test.go; added an end-to-end regression in tests/e2e/openai_compat_stop.test.js that reproduces the customer case; performance microbenchmarks show <2% median latency impact on 1k token streams. Docs & migration notes: updated docs/redwood-docs/openai-compat.md to clarify `stop` handling and the new `stream_logprobs` param, and added a migration note for customers using streaming SDKs. Checklist: - [x] Runtime streaming framer changes implemented - [x] Compat-layer stop handling implemented and covered by unit tests - [x] Function-calling ordering guarantees added - [x] Unit and e2e tests added and passing locally - [x] Docs updated and linked - [x] CI green and PR approved Related work: Linear ENG-4217 (stop/stream parity), ENG-4280 (function-calling stability) Links: https://linear.app/ENG/issue/ENG-4217 https://linear.app/ENG/issue/ENG-4280

release_notes: Fixes streaming incompatibilities with OpenAI /v1 chat: deterministic framing, correct stop token propagation across function calls, opt-in streaming logprobs, and role normalization. No breaking API changes but clients using custom streaming parsers should review migration notes in openai-compat docs.
